# ChinaMed Access

> ChinaMed Access is an international patient coordination platform connecting overseas patients with accredited hospitals and qualified specialists in Shanghai, China. We coordinate case review, appointments, translation, travel, treatment logistics and follow-up care. We are NOT a hospital and do not provide medical treatment.

## Key Facts

- ChinaMed Access coordinates international patient journeys to accredited Shanghai hospitals; medical decisions are made by treating physicians.
- Specialist network includes hepatobiliary/pancreatic oncology (Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center), joint surgery (Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital), cardiology (Zhongshan Hospital) and acupuncture (Longhua Hospital) — from public hospital profiles.
- Services include cancer care, surgery/orthopedics, clinical trial information, internal medicine, TCM/rehabilitation and health check-ups.
- Hospital medical fees are paid directly to the hospital; coordination service fees are itemized separately.
- China's inbound medical tourism is growing: ~73,200 foreign patient visits to Shanghai public hospitals in 2025 (+8% YoY); ~12,800 medical-tourism visits to Hainan Boao Lecheng in 2025.

## Compliance

ChinaMed Access is a coordination service, not a medical institution. Per China's Medical Advertisement Recognition Guidelines (2025), non-medical institutions may not publish medical advertisements. We publish objective, authorized hospital and physician information and coordinate patient needs with hospitals for independent medical evaluation. We do not promise cure rates or guarantee clinical trial enrollment. Patient stories are anonymized.
